dreamteamer.title: NotebookLM
dreamteamer.description: Renders the workspace for NotebookLM: `dt notebooklm` writes the schema, the records and a persona as a bounded set of sources (and, given a notebook, syncs them), and the `notebooklm` harness keeps NOTEBOOKLM.md's configuration block current. Collections marked `sensitive: true` and fields marked `x-sensitive: true` never travel. Inlined here as a workspace module with an extension entry: the package it was extracted as is not published.
